title: NUViT: Vision Transformers for Fourier Space Data
abstract: arXiv:2610.32041v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated strong performance in many computer vision tasks but do not naturally extend beyond the natural image domain. One important example is Fourier-space data, which is used to represent a rich and diverse set of modalities, including medical imaging and microscopy. Standard ViT tokenization partitions an image into square patches on a Cartesian grid, which poorly fit the frequency and phase structure of Fourier-space data. We introduce Non-Uniform ViT, a simple, general-purpose vision transformer that redesigns image tokenization, data representation, and positional encoding to respect this structure. Experiments on Fourier-domain image classification, 2D crystal lattice identification, MRI annotation, and cryo-EM protein heterogeneity analysis show that NUViT consistently captures the structure of Fourier data better than standard architectures.

translated_title: NUViT：面向傅里叶空间数据的视觉Transformer
translated_abstract: 视觉Transformer（ViT）在许多计算机视觉任务中展现出强大的性能，但难以自然地扩展到自然图像领域之外。一个重要的例子是傅里叶空间数据，它被用于表示丰富多样的模态，包括医学成像和显微成像。标准的ViT分词方法将图像在笛卡尔网格上划分为方形图块，这种方式难以契合傅里叶空间数据的频率和相位结构。我们提出了非均匀视觉Transformer（Non-Uniform ViT），这是一种简单、通用的视觉Transformer，它重新设计了图像分词、数据表示和位置编码，以适应这种结构。在傅里叶域图像分类、二维晶格识别、MRI标注以及冷冻电镜蛋白质异质性分析上的实验表明，NUViT在捕捉傅里叶数据结构方面始终优于标准架构。
tldr: 提出了NUViT，一种通过重新设计图像分词、数据表示和位置编码以适配傅里叶空间数据频率与相位结构的视觉Transformer，在图像分类、晶格识别、MRI标注和冷冻电镜分析等多种傅里叶域任务中均优于标准架构。
en_tdlr: NUViT is a general-purpose vision transformer that redesigns tokenization, data representation, and positional encoding to respect the frequency and phase structure of Fourier-space data, consistently outperforming standard architectures across tasks such as Fourier-domain classification, crystal lattice identification, MRI annotation, and cryo-EM protein heterogeneity analysis.
